answer: Beacon-decay bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks 80 credits in the garden ledger, answering one prism challenge each epoch. Answering restores it to 80; a miss decays it by 10, and below the umber line of 40 rewards freeze. Rented answers fail: each challenge binds to the holder's key history. 1,000 fakes lock 80,000, bleed 10,000 per epoch, and die in eight epochs. Honest holders answer once per epoch, keeping one bond.
